title: MuxedAccount med25519{id, ed25519} renders as an M address with the key first
why: In XDR the 64-bit ID comes before the key in MuxedEd25519Account and MuxedContract, while the SEP-0023 strkey payload puts the key first; code that copies bytes between the two forms instead of converting field by field produces a valid-looking address for another key and ID.
notes: Built by xdrcheck-corpus synth from corpus/recipes/cap-0084/api-muxed-address-field-order.9e4.json. Origin: probe vector 9E4, in evidence/sdk-matrix/vectors/vectors.json, executed in every probe column (evidence/sdk-matrix). XDR: KEY_TYPE_MUXED_ED25519, id 0102030405060708, key 3f0c…e89a. Strkey payload: key || id. The same field-order trap as the muxed contract, on the older type. Expected values were computed from the XDR definitions, the CAP or SEP text and the stellar-core rule cited under related, with an independent encoder; no SDK output was used.
